label: Google Drive: List Files
description: List files the connected account can see (name + id + mime type), optionally filtered by a Drive query. Needs the read-all-of-Drive permission.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Google access (wire a GoogleAccess node). Browsing all of Drive needs the read-all-of-Drive permission; Google classes it restricted, so a shared app covering it is rare and your own app is the usual road.

inputs.name: query
inputs.label: Query
inputs.description: A Drive search query (the API's `q` parameter). Empty lists everything visible.

outputs.name: files
outputs.description: The listed files: {id, name, mimeType} each.
